name: notice-stack
title: Notice stack
description: Several notices in one place: the most urgent on top, the rest folded under '+2 more', each closable on its own.
docs: notices is a list of { id, tone, title, body, action, dismissible } in any order: the stack sorts it by tone (error, warning, info) and keeps your order within a level. max (default 1) is how many show in full; the rest fold under a +N more button, whose name carries the count and which unfolds them in place. A dismissible notice has a close button that calls onDismiss(id); remove it from notices and the next one comes forward and takes focus. A notice that arrives after the first paint is announced politely, and an error is announced once, as an alert; what is there on load is not announced. Only errors use colour: a warning and information differ by icon, weight and the word read before the title. label names the region. labels carries every word.
